verdict.rationale: Railway's own docs describe managed app deployment: you connect a repo, Railway auto-configures and deploys it, and networking, SSL, load balancing and scaling are handled for you, so full-stack apps run with no servers to manage. Nothing in the evidence documents a serverless-functions offering. missing for 10: documented serverless functions capability, independent or hands-on corroboration of the managed full-stack deployment flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps with no servers to manage

citations.quote: Connect your repo, Railway handles the rest. Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.
Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.
Scale CPU and RAM or add replicas with load balancing.
Railway is an all-in-one intelligent cloud provider that makes it easy to provision infrastructure, develop locally, and deploy to the cloud.
